items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: The members of Charlie's band were Ben Witted, Harvey Boone... Frank and myself on trumpets

ctx.x: Don opened in Connie's with all the musicians that had recorded with him except Red Allen, Leonard Davis and myself. His three trumpets were Sidney de Paris, Shirley Clay and Langston Curl.

Dickie Wells was playing with Charlie Johnson who left Small's Paradise in 1931. Charlie asked Frank Newton and myself to join his band. I accepted because Charlie was better known than Neal and the salary would be better also. The members of Charlie's band were Ben Witted,
Harvey Boone, alto sax, Benny Waters, tenor, Bobby Johnson, guitar, Dell Thomas, bass, Leonard 'Ham' Davis, Frank and myself on trumpets, Dickie on trombone and George Stafford, drums.
